title: When two dispatchers reorder the same technician, the later drop wins
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • [User-B]: a second dispatcher with Work Orders create and edit at the same location, signed in in a second browser (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two"). Browser 1 = you, browser 2 = [User-B].
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Charlie Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Bravo Co", "Charlie Co").
  • Work orders (Approved), lead Ana: Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co. Nobody has reordered Ana's work, so both browsers show Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two"; skip if one exists) with a role that has Work Orders View and Create & Edit at this location. Record as [User-B] and sign them in in browser 2.
  3. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins Charlie Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins" in Search — exactly 3 work orders show, all Approved and led by Ana; Board View's Ana column reads Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co in both browsers. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. In both browsers open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Later Drop Wins" and click Board View.
  2. In browser 1, drag Charlie Co to the top of Ana's column and release.
  3. In browser 2, without refreshing, drag Bravo Co to the top of Ana's column and release.
  4. In browser 1, watch the screen for a warning, then refresh.
  5. In browser 2, refresh.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: browser 1 shows no warning about the other change.
  • After browser 1 refreshes, Ana's column shows browser 2's saved order: Bravo Co, Alpha Co, Charlie Co (the later save wins).
  • Step 5: browser 2 shows the same order, Bravo Co, Alpha Co, Charlie Co.
  • If either browser shows "The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again." or "The board is busy with another move. Please try again.", the card goes back to where it was. Write it down; that is a different, allowed outcome checked in the Story 4 cases.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R11, S4-N11, S4-N12, read 8 Oct 2026. Concurrency decision: Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-35 (Chris Ward, 28 Sep 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R11: “Save the manual order of work orders once per location. Everyone at the location sees the same order, in both Tech View and Board View. If two people reorder at the same time, the later save wins; the other person sees the saved order on their next refresh and is not warned.”
  • S4-N11: “A card dropped next to a work order that someone else has just moved is not saved. The alert reads “The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”
  • S4-N12: “When two people drop into the same technician at the same moment and the second cannot be saved in time, the alert reads “The board is busy with another move. Please try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
